description: This file defines a plugin component for auto-embedding content (like YouTube videos and Tweets) in a rich text editor, including configuration objects, UI components, and modal dialog logic.

classes.name: PlaygroundEmbedConfig
classes.description: Interface extending EmbedConfig with additional properties for embed content configuration.

classes.name: AutoEmbedOption
classes.description: Class representing an option in the auto-embed menu, with key and callback.

methods.name: debounce
methods.description: Creates a debounced version of a callback function with specified delay.

methods.name: AutoEmbedDialog
methods.description: React component for the modal dialog to input URL and trigger embedding.

methods.name: AutoEmbedMenuItem
methods.description: React component representing a single item in the auto-embed options menu.

methods.name: AutoEmbedMenu
methods.description: React component rendering the list of auto-embed options.

methods.name: AutoEmbedPlugin
methods.description: Main React component integrating the auto-embed functionality into the editor.
